editorial:
You follow Nathan Drake, a clever young thief, and his partner Sully as they chase a huge treasure and clues about Nathan’s missing brother. The movie moves fast, mixing jokes, globe-trotting clues, and big action scenes. It feels like a fun video game brought to life, with bright locations and a playful tone. Even if you never played the games, you can jump right in and enjoy the ride.

The action is the main draw, especially the plane cargo sequence and the flying ships finale. Tom Holland and Mark Wahlberg have easy banter, though some jokes land better than others. The story is simple and predictable, but the pace keeps you entertained from start to finish. Watch it with friends if you want light adventure, not deep drama.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Nathan and Sully find the treasure ships, but Braddock and her crew attack. Nathan fights Braddock on a flying ship, and she falls to her death. Nathan and Sully escape with some gold, while Chloe takes a piece and leaves. Later, Nathan learns his brother Sam is alive in prison, setting up another adventure. Sully also gets his mustache back, hinting at more treasure hunts ahead.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves treasure hunts, buddy comedy, and big action set pieces.
